prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished full-bleed fantasy trading-card artwork for Realms of Varhyr, portrait 2:3, 1024x1536.
Primary request: An Ancient Unicorn, a rare and unforgettable creature that channels the energy of every realm.
Scene/backdrop: a deep old-growth forest clearing, enormous weathered trees, moss-covered stone and soft drifting mist, a pool catching dawn light.
Subject: a single majestic, ancient ivory unicorn in three-quarter profile, anatomically convincing horse, long silver mane, a long ridged spiral horn, wise dark eye, subtle age and weathering. Its horn and breath scatter delicate prismatic light into the mist, a restrained suggestion of universal magic rather than rainbow ribbons.
Style/medium: mature, richly painterly fantasy oil painting; visible confident brushwork, textured canvas, layered earthy pigments, carefully painted anatomy, atmospheric depth. Traditional illustrated fantasy book-cover quality, warm ochre highlights against cool forest greens, restrained luminous accents. Neither photorealistic nor a smooth digital render.
Composition/framing: creature large and clearly readable, head, horn and shoulders in the upper-middle area so the card's title and stats at the bottom do not cover the face. A quiet lower foreground. Dramatic but dignified and mysterious; no cute or cartoon styling.
Lighting/mood: dawn shafts through branches, luminous ivory coat and horn against the deep forest, painterly chiaroscuro, solemn wonder.
Constraints: exactly one unicorn, exactly one horn, natural horse anatomy, no wings, no riders, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark, no card frame or UI. Opaque full scene.
